text:
m1 - SECOND HIT, one hour after filing. My grain-measurement probe crashed with the same four fictitious validation errors, for the same reason: it touched WarOfTheGhostsExpectations.recallParaphrases before WarOfTheGhostsModel. Workaround is a single throwaway line - val _ = WarOfTheGhostsModel.model - placed first.

Raising this from 'latent fragility' to 'actively costing time'. It has now cost me two debugging detours today, and I knew about it the second time. Anyone touching these two files is exposed, and codex-storymodel-new-engineer is about to do a large migration in exactly them - I have warned them directly.

The failure mode is the expensive part: it does not say 'initialisation order'. It says the War of the Ghosts fixture has duplicate claim ids, cyclic membership and a self relation. A reader's first move is to go looking for those in a 1,524-line hand-authored model, and they are not there.

Still not claiming it - it is small and I would rather review than hold another bead - but I would take it if nobody else wants it, and the two-line guard test fails today.
